name: Smart Admin Assistant
author: bdthemes

sections.description:
Smart Admin Assistant is a modular WordPress plugin that consolidates essential admin functionality into a single, cohesive interface. Instead of installing multiple plugins for different admin enhancements, users get everything they need in one well-designed package.

🏗️ Architecture

The plugin follows a modular architecture with:
* 9 Core Modules – Each handling specific functionality
* Custom Settings System – Database-driven settings with AJAX interface
* Modern Admin Interface – Dark theme with responsive design
* Security First – All features built with WordPress security best practices

📋 Features Breakdown

✅ Content Management Module
* Auto-Generate Excerpts – Automatically create excerpts for posts without manual excerpts
* Customizable Excerpt Length – Set word count (10-500 words)
* One-Click Post Duplication – Duplicate posts, pages, and custom post types
* Complete Data Copy – Includes meta fields, taxonomies, and custom fields
* Role-Based Access – Control which user roles can duplicate content
* Redirect Options – Choose between edit screen or list view after duplication
* Custom Post Ordering – Drag & drop ordering for hierarchical post types
* Media Replacement – Replace files while keeping URLs and links intact
* SVG Upload Support – Secure SVG upload with sanitization
* AVIF Upload Support – Modern image format support
* Media Categories – Organize media library with taxonomies
* External Permalinks – Posts/pages can redirect to external URLs
* Open in New Tab Option – Control whether external permalinks open in new tab
* Auto-Publish Missed Posts – Automatically publish missed scheduled posts
* Draft Preview – Public preview links for draft content

✅ Admin Interface Enhancements Module
* Admin Bar Customization – Hide/show elements, add custom items
* Dashboard Widgets – Custom dashboard layout and widgets
* Menu Organization – Reorder and customize admin menus
* List Table Enhancements – Custom columns and bulk actions
* Admin Color Schemes – Custom admin themes
* Login Screen Customization – Branding and layout options

✅ Component Disabling Module
* Gutenberg Control – Disable/enable block editor per post type
* Comments Management – Disable comments globally or selectively
* Dashboard Components – Remove unnecessary dashboard elements
* Admin Features – Disable unused WordPress features
* Frontend Elements – Remove WordPress branding and unnecessary elements

✅ Additional Modules Coming Soon
* Login & User Management Module
* Custom Code Integration Module
* Security Module
* Performance Optimization Module
* Utilities Module
* Additional Features Module

🎨 Admin Interface

  • Modern Dark Theme – Professional dark interface with gradient accents
  • Responsive Design – Works perfectly on all device sizes
  • Module Toggle System – Easy enable/disable for each module
  • AJAX Form Handling – Smooth, no-reload form submissions
  • Real-time Notifications – Success/error feedback system
  • Settings Export/Import – Backup and restore plugin settings
  • Search Functionality – Quick module search and filtering

🛠️ Technical Implementation

Plugin Architecture
* Modular Design – Each feature is a separate, loadable module
* Singleton Pattern – Efficient memory usage and initialization
* Hook System – Proper WordPress hook integration
* Autoloading – Automatic class loading and dependency management

Settings System
* Custom Database Table – wp_bdtsaa_settings for efficient storage
* Caching Layer – In-memory settings caching for performance
* AJAX Handlers – Multiple AJAX endpoints for real-time updates
* Data Sanitization – Comprehensive input sanitization and validation

Security Implementation
* Nonce Verification – All AJAX calls use WordPress nonces
* Capability Checks – User permission verification on all actions
* Input Sanitization – All user input properly sanitized
* Role-Based Access – Granular permission control per feature

Credits

Developed by: Smart Admin Assistant Team
Architecture: Modular WordPress plugin design
UI/UX: Modern dark theme with responsive design
Security: WordPress security best practices
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/smart-admin-assistant/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to ‘Smart Admin’ in your admin menu to configure the plugin.
  4. Enable and configure each module as needed.
  5. Save settings and start using the features.

Requirements

  • WordPress: 5.0 or higher
  • PHP: 7.4 or higher
  • MySQL: 5.6 or higher
  • Admin Access: Required for configuration

Quick Start Guide

  1. Enable Content Management – Start with content duplication and media features
  2. Configure User Roles – Set who can access advanced features
  3. Test Features – Try duplicating a post to verify functionality
  4. Explore Settings – Review all available options in each module
  5. Export Settings – Backup your configuration
sections.faq:
Which modules are fully functional in the current version?

The Content Management module is fully implemented with all features. The Admin Interface and Component Disabling modules have core functionality working, with additional features being added. Other modules are in development.

Is this plugin compatible with multisite?

Multisite support is planned for future releases but not fully implemented in the current version.

Can I disable features I don’t need?

Yes, each module can be enabled or disabled independently, and many features within modules have their own toggle options.

Does this plugin modify core WordPress files?

No, Smart Admin Assistant uses WordPress hooks and APIs to extend functionality without modifying core files.

Will this plugin slow down my site?

The plugin is designed with performance in mind, using efficient code practices, caching, and modular loading to minimize impact on site speed.

  • Core structure for Admin Interface and Component Disabling modules
  • Framework for additional modules in place
